# WB22 · Chi tiết lịch hẹn · lịch đã đổi ở cửa sổ khác

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-data.js#setStatus`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `operations-data.js › setStatus(id, status)` refuses unless the booking is still active and the target is `confirmed` or `arrived`. Two tabs share the browser storage: the second tab cancels the booking while the first dialog is open, then "Xác nhận lịch" in the first tab fails.
- Inventory note: Two browser tabs: the booking dialog stays open in the first tab while the second tab cancels the same booking; "Xác nhận lịch" then fails with this line.
- Page key `schedule` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"schedule\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"edit\"]"} → {"wait":"#booking-form"} → {"tab":[{"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"},{"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"schedule\"]"},{"click":"[data-ops=\"edit\"]"},{"wait":"#booking-form"},{"fill":["#cancel-reason","Khách báo bận"]},{"click":"[data-ops=\"cancel\"]"},{"wait":".toast"}]} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"confirm\"]"}; it must show "Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này.".

Kit components used: Field×8, Button×6, Dialog×1, Badge×1; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- 30 phút điều trị + 0 phút chuẩn bị · 300.000 ₫ · theo lịch đã đặt
- Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "30 phút điều trị + 0 phút chuẩn bị · 300.000 ₫ · theo lịch đã đặt"
- (old web notice) "Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này."
- "Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này." (only confirmed and arrived are valid targets of an active booking).

## Differences from the app design
- App F9 has no conflict handling between windows; the web shows the line in the dialog and keeps it open.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F9: "30 phút điều trị + 0 phút chuẩn bị · 300.000 ₫ · theo lịch đã đặt"
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F9: "Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này."

## Gotchas
- The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.
- The chip still reads "Đặt hẹn" because the dialog was not redrawn after the other tab changed the data.
